fix.pr_body:
## What was wrong

The `/bugs/` page had a plain browser-default checkbox to toggle visibility of cards not legal in Penny Dreadful. The checkbox had no `id` attribute, so the `<label for="toggle_illegal">` was not properly associated with it. The checkbox visual also did not match the site's button style conventions.

## What changed

- **`decksite/templates/bugs.mustache`**: Added `id="toggle_illegal"` to the checkbox so the label association works correctly.
- **`shared_web/static/css/pd.css`**: Replaced the trivial `.toggle-illegal { margin-left: 0 }` rule with CSS that visually hides the native checkbox (opacity/position/dimensions zeroed) and styles the adjacent `<label>` as a toggle button matching the site's existing `.button` conventions (same border-radius, font-size, padding, color variables). When the checkbox is checked, the label gets the site's highlight background color to show active state. No JavaScript changes were needed — the existing `change` event listener on `.toggle-illegal` continues to work since the hidden checkbox still receives programmatic events.

## How it was validated

- `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed
- `uv run --frozen python dev.py unit` — 848 passed, 1 skipped, 89 deselected

Fixes #11201
